title: 重载 - 两数之和
problem_statement_md:
完善**add**()函数，接收两个数值类型参数，并打印两参数之和。

需要重载`add()`函数，支持`int` 和 `double` 类型参数传递。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Function overloading[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Complete the [b]add()[/b] function so that it will calculate the [b]sum of two numbers given as arguments[/b].
Overload it in order to do the same operation with double type values.

[note]The calls of the functions are already written.
Don't forget about line breaks.
[/note]
hint_md:
- 函数的调用已经写好了。
- 不要忘记换行。
